paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better

model_annotation: The plot illustrates how the metric “Informativeness” changes across five discrete x-axis positions for two conditions labeled “w.o. extension” and “extension” (captioned LLaMA-2-7B). The x-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and shows integer values from 0 to 4 with ticks at every 1 unit. The y-axis is labeled “Informativeness,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.920 to 0.970 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.920, 0.930, 0.940, 0.950, 0.960, and 0.970. The “w.o. extension” series is drawn as a blue dashed line with circular markers and decreases from about 0.968 at x=0 to about 0.959 at x=1, 0.940 at x=2, ~0.925 at x=3, and ~0.916–0.917 at x=4. The “extension” series is drawn as an orange solid line with upward triangle markers and similarly decreases from about 0.968 at x=0 to about 0.960 at x=1, ~0.941 at x=2, ~0.927 at x=3, and ~0.918–0.919 at x=4.
